words.def: to use a time, chance or resource in the best possible way.
words.book: To ensure we make the most of our time together, let's proceed with the agenda.
uses: Email
To make the most of the site visit, please have the UPS logs ready before we arrive.
Chat
we only have 30 min with the client, let's make the most of it 💪
Meeting
Let's make the most of this slot and agree on the maintenance scope today.
goes: make the most of our time
make the most of the opportunity
make the most of the budget
dont: We want to benefit from the time very well.
doo: Let's make the most of our time.

words.ar: له دور أساسي / كان سبب رئيسي
words.def: very important in making something happen.
words.book: He has been with the company for several years and has played an instrumental role in delivering several successful projects.
uses: Email
Ahmed was instrumental in closing the data-centre deal with the bank.
Chat
tbh omar was instrumental in fixing that VFD issue 🙌
Meeting
Our service team played an instrumental role in keeping the hospital's UPS running.
dont: He was a main reason in the success of the project.
doo: He was instrumental in the project's success.

words.def: to focus mainly on one type of product, service or skill.
words.book: Our company specializes in technology solutions, and we're interested in exploring new marketing strategies.
uses: Email
We specialize in the supply and maintenance of UPS systems and battery banks.
Chat
do they specialize in solar or just resell panels?
Meeting
Our team specializes in data-centre power solutions, from design to maintenance.
dont: Our company is specialist on UPS.
doo: Our company specializes in UPS systems.

words.def: a short description of the main points of something, without the details.
words.book: Can you each introduce yourselves and give us a brief overview of your organization?
uses: Email
Attached is a brief overview of our preventive maintenance packages.
Chat
can u give me a quick overview of the Heliopolis site before the call?
Meeting
Let me start with a quick overview of last quarter's service tickets.
dont: I will give you a general idea summary about the company.
doo: Let me give you a brief overview of the company.

words.def: a small change made to improve something or make it work better.
words.book: Our purpose today is to discuss the progress we've made on our current project, as well as to make any necessary adjustments to our plan.
uses: Email
We've made a few adjustments to the quotation based on your feedback.
Chat
small adjustment: site visit moved to 10 am 👍
Meeting
We may need to make some adjustments to the delivery schedule.
dont: We will do some modifies on the plan.
doo: We'll make some adjustments to the plan.

words.def: wanting very much to do or have something.
words.book: Our company provides a range of financial services, and we're eager to learn more about your ideas for marketing.
uses: Email
We're eager to start the installation as soon as the PO is issued.
Chat
client is eager to get the new batteries in asap
Meeting
We're eager to hear your feedback on the pilot solar system.
dont: We are very excited for to start the project.
doo: We're eager to start the project.

upgrade.plain: Sorry, I am late because of the traffic.
pro: My apologies for running behind schedule.
I am sorry for my lateness because traffic.
upgrade.why: اعتذار مهني قصير من غير أعذار كتير: ‎My apologies for …‎

upgrade.plain: I will introduce myself. I am Ahmed from the sales.
upgrade.ar: هعرّفكم بنفسي، أنا أحمد من المبيعات
pro: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Ahmed, from the sales team.
I will present me. I am Ahmed from the sales.
Let me to introduce myself, Ahmed.
upgrade.why: ابدأ بـ ‎Allow me to introduce myself‎، ومتقولش ‎present me‎.

upgrade.plain: Tell us who are you and what is your job.
pro: Tell us who are you and your job.
Say your name and what you do.
Could you please introduce yourself and your role in the company?
upgrade.why: السؤال المباشر ده حاد؛ ابدأ بـ ‎Could you please …‎ عشان يبقى مؤدب.

pro: I'd like to extend a warm welcome to our guests.
upgrade.why: ‎extend a warm welcome to‎ = ترحيب رسمي ودافي بالضيوف.

upgrade.plain: The meeting today is for talking about the new contract.
upgrade.ar: الاجتماع النهارده عشان نتكلم عن عقد الصيانة الجديد
pro: The meeting is for speak about the contract.
The meeting today, we will talk in the new contract.
Our objective for this meeting is to review the new maintenance contract.
upgrade.why: افتح الاجتماع بهدف واضح: ‎Our objective for this meeting is to …‎

upgrade.plain: Let's see the points of the meeting first so we are all same.
upgrade.ar: خلينا نشوف نقط الاجتماع الأول عشان نبقى كلنا فاهمين نفس الحاجة
pro: Let's see the points first so we are all same.
Let's go over the agenda to make sure we're on the same page.
We look on the agenda to be same idea.
upgrade.why: ‎on the same page‎ = متفقين وفاهمين نفس الحاجة.
